source.check: candidates, votes, the number of electors on the register and the result read from the photographed page of the register (owner's PRONI photographs, transcribed 11 Nov 2026); names as the register writes them, surname first; the register gives no party labels

note: By-election of a councillor for Duncairn Ward, 16 June 1937, to fill a casual vacancy. Returned unopposed. Register remarks: vice Councillor Bradbury resigned. The register's reading of the surname is confirmed by the Belfast News-Letter of 25 May 1937, p. 5, which names the Unionist candidate as Mr. T. B. Doxford, M.A., of Trooperslane, son-in-law of Sir George Clark.
correctionNote: Checked on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 25 May 1937, p. 5 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the paper prints Mr. T. B. Doxford, so the register's uncertain reading Doxford is confirmed and the note no longer marks it uncertain; the paper is added to the citation.
